author: dravenip
text:
YOU CAN NOW TYPE ONE SENTENCE AND GET A REAL ANIMATION YOU CAN DROP INTO YOUR APP

Most AI animation tools give you a video.

One size, one color scheme, one shot. Want it slower? Generate it again.

@LottieFiles went the other way: it's called Lottie AI and it generates motion as vector code, not pixels.

Picture this:

You describe a "Post" button in one sentence.
About a minute later it's playing: it presses, turns into a gold loader and lands on a checkmark.
It even wired up the click states on its own.
You type "switch it to dark mode" and the same animation changes in 36 seconds.
Then you recolor it from the controls, no new prompt.

That's what it covers:

→ Prompt to animation in plain English, plus click or hover interactivity
→ Follow-up prompts change the animation you already have
→ Controls built for each animation: color, text, sizes, timing
→ The actual motion code, which you can read and edit
→ Exports to dotLottie, Lottie JSON, GIF or MP4 (mine came out at ~26 KB)

It's best at UI motion: buttons, loaders, icons, onboarding screens.

We went from rendering a video to shipping the animation itself.

📌 Save this for the next time your app needs motion. Link in the comment below 👇

author: frontm_an
text:
opus 5.5 + remotion + gsap = your own f*cking motion design lab.

give claude code a motion reference and let it break the animation into 6 editable controls:

→ spacing: control how far objects move between poses.

→ typography: adjust text size, spacing, and line breaks.

→ motion blur: control how much blur appears during fast movements.

→ easing: fine-tune how movements speed up and slow down.

→ follow-through: make the tail finish moving after the main object stops.

→ anticipation: add a small backward movement before the main action.

keep everything in one config file.

now you can give feedback like:

“add 4 frames of anticipation.”

“delay the tail by 3 frames.”

“hold the title for 1 second.”

the workflow:

build → render → scrub → adjust → repeat.

the official remotion + gsap integration keeps the animation synced with remotion’s frame clock.

author: bekhovsgun
text:
can gaussian splats be used to render interfaces?

I've seen a lot of incredible spatial demos coming out of the labs (@theworldlabs has been blowing my mind ~weekly), but they've mainly been focused on static 3D environments. I woke up today wondering: are splats any good for UI or other interactive objects, and can AI work with them?

it looks like the answer is yes and yes. I prototyped an imagen -> SHARP -> spark -> popmelt pipeline that gets decently far on the first try and really far with a few rounds of art direction + interaction tuning. Smooth animation, dynamic lighting, realistic geometry... all doable, with freely available tech

I haven't pushed into full scenes yet, but this experiment already felt somewhere between the detailed magic of generative video UI I've shared before and the stable dependability of textured 3D models (throwback). Plus LLMs like Astra are very good at working with splats, which makes fine tuning them way more fun/efficient

next: I'm weighing whether to lean into interactive spatial design (just to see how far I can get with off the shelf tools) OR see how well this workflow handles typical responsive UI design (decidedly not what splats are for, which feels interesting). thoughts?
effect_zh: 用高斯溅射（Gaussian splats）渲染可交互界面的空间 UI 实验（imagen → SHARP → spark → popmelt）

author: sorenxet
text:
Build a full original game in 24 hours with Claude Opus 5.5 + Flux 3 Max + GPT Image + Tripo + Blender + Three.js...

Every level, character and prop traced back to one generated video.

The step by step workflow:

01 / Flux 3 Max generates the reference video. Look, world and character all come from it.
02 / Screenshots from that video get rebuilt as assets in Blender and placed in Three.js, with Claude Code agents building and checking in parallel.
03 / The character gets 4 side views from GPT Image, a 3D model from Tripo, and cloth physics plus animations from Opus.
04 / The prototype gets played before anything else is built.
05 / GPT Image turns the art style into concept art for each level, up to 8 images per level.
06 / The agents build every scene, then the loop starts: play, report bugs, fix, improve, repeat.

The rule: test the first playable before the agents build the rest. A broken prototype becomes eight broken levels.

Opus and the agents do the building. 
You do the playing and the bug reports.

(built by xikhar)
effect_zh: 24 小时用 Claude Opus + Flux + Tripo + Blender + Three.js 做出完整原创小游戏，关卡角色道具全链路 AI+3D 工作流备查。

author: cutetoxicguy
text:
🎮 You can now turn a text prompt into a textured, rigged and animated 3D game character on your own Mac. No cloud GPU required.

Meet AssetFurnace, an open-source production pipeline created by @bingeljell.

Instead of generating a static 3D model and leaving you to handle everything else, AssetFurnace connects the entire process.

Prompt → Image → 3D Mesh → Cleanup → Rig → Animation → GLB.

What can it do?

▪️ Concept generation: Create a character from a text prompt or import your own reference art.

▪️ Image-to-3D: Choose between Pixal3D, TRELLIS.2 and Hunyuan3D.

▪️ Mesh preparation: Clean geometry, adjust materials and choose the target polygon count.

▪️ Automatic rigging: Generate a humanoid skeleton with approximately 34–52 bones.

▪️ Animation: Apply walking, running, combat, dancing and other motion presets.

▪️ Engine-ready export: Produce a single GLB containing the mesh, textures, skeleton and animation.

The result can be opened in Godot, Unity, Unreal Engine, Blender or Three.js.

The technical details are surprisingly practical.

▪️ Selectable geometry budgets: 5K, 15K, 40K or 100K triangles.

▪️ 2K textures with color, normal and material information.

▪️ Multiple levels of detail for props.

▪️ Nine-prop generation from one 3×3 reference sheet.

▪️ Local generation on Apple Silicon and NVIDIA hardware.

▪️ An MCP server for Claude Code, Codex and other compatible agents.

There's also something particularly useful: license tracking.

Every generated asset includes provenance information identifying the models used during production and their licenses.

That's important because combining open models doesn't automatically make every resulting workflow unrestricted.

Performance and requirements:

The developer reports that a complete character can be created in roughly 15 minutes on an M-series MacBook, depending on configuration.

Recommended hardware:

▪️ Apple Silicon with 32GB unified memory.

▪️ NVIDIA GPU with 24GB VRAM in the tested Linux setup.

▪️ 8–20GB of downloads per 3D model backend.

What does it cost?

The local application is free and Apache-2.0 licensed.

An optional cloud service starts at approximately $0.20 per generation.

But there are limitations.

Current automatic rigging focuses on humanoid characters.

Fast movements can produce unnatural deformations, extreme poses may stretch the geometry, and the generated triangles aren't a substitute for clean quad topology.

Still, this is the kind of integration that makes AI 3D useful to actual game developers.

Generating a model is only the first step. Generating something that can move inside a game is much more valuable.

🌐 

💻

effect_zh: AssetFurnace：本地 Mac 上把文字提示变成可绑定动画的 3D 游戏角色，开源无云 GPU。

author: awe0_io
text:
跟 AI 说「网页背景做得高级一点」

结果不是纯黑，就是蓝紫色渐变？

因为你没告诉 AI，具体想要哪种背景效果。

其实这些高级背景都有名字，直接告诉 AI 就好：

1. Mesh Gradient：网格渐变，多种颜色像颜料一样自然融合，整个背景柔和又有层次。
2. Aurora Background：极光背景，彩色光带缓慢流动，像夜空中的极光。
3. Noise Texture：噪点纹理，在背景上叠加细微颗粒，让画面不再有廉价的塑料感。
4. Dot Grid：点阵网格，用整齐排列的小圆点构成背景，科技感十足。
5. Spotlight Effect：聚光灯效果，鼠标移动到哪里，哪里的背景就被照亮。
6. Animated Gradient：动态渐变，让背景颜色缓慢流动，画面更有生命力。

下次直接说：

「首页使用 Aurora Background，背景叠加轻微 Noise Texture，鼠标交互使用 Spotlight Effect，整体保持简洁高级。」

一句话，AI 就知道背景应该怎么设计。
effect_zh: 教 AI 写高级网页背景：直接点名 Mesh Gradient、Aurora Background、Noise、Dot Grid、Spotlight、Animated Gradient。视频演示各类背景效果，和 dada 的极光背景配方高度相关，可直接当 prompt 词汇表用。

它主要输出 SVG、WebGL 和三维交互画面，适合承担技术讲解、科普视频里的可视化环节，完整成片还需要另行录制或编排。



2. lemo-opuscar（约 1.12 万 Star）

🍋大佬，超级实用的skill，制作口播视频分分钟搞定！！提供 66 种现成风格，附示例影片、风格提示词和制作指南。

选一种画风，再告诉 Claude 想讲什么，就能沿着这套流程制作短片；也支持发展自己的风格。画面通过代码绘制和渲染，配乐、旁白也纳入制作流程。



3. pixelfx（约 3540 Star）

最近非常爆火的，4天快3.6k，244 个像素特效：火焰、爆炸、闪电、魔法、天气，还有完整的攻击动作。

每个效果都是一小段代码，可以预览、换色、镜像和导出精灵图。附带的 Claude Code Skill 会按“先画、渲染、观察、修改”的流程制作新特效，适合像素动画和游戏风短片里的效果素材。



4. huashu-motion（约 2130 Star）

花叔出品，必属精品！偏产品发布片和宣传动效。给它产品资料，它会先提出创意方向，再制作画面和配乐。

比较有意思的是修改方式：在预览画面上点中某个位置，直接说哪里要改，反馈会带上时间点和元素信息。标题、颜色、数字、停留时间等，也可以在编辑器里调整。



5. animate（约 1410 Star）

用代码制作讲解短片、历史故事和小动画，内置剪纸、钢笔排线、孔版印刷、速写本、数学、像素、等轴测 7 种风格，也支持根据参考图开发新画风。

它把确认环节放在前面：先看故事节奏，再看风格图和分镜，确认后才制作动画。适合对画风和叙事都有明确要求的人。



6. teardown（约 1280 Star）

让 Claude Code 把机器做成可以旋转、观察和拆解的三维模拟器。发动机怎样运转、起落架怎样收起，都能边看动作、边看对应的参数。

最终可以得到离线交互网页，也能逐帧录制成 60fps 视频。适合机械原理、结构拆解和工程科普，仓库提供了三个完整案例供参考。



7. vibe-knowledge-film（约 950 Star）

面向知识类短片，提供“夜曲”和“寓言”两种表达方向：前者讲抽象、难懂的知识，后者把心理和行为逻辑演成故事。

给它选题或文案，它会整理字幕、分镜和音效，先做约 30 秒样片，确认后再继续全片。仓库中的对照样片用于学习，不能直接当作自己的作品发布。



8. motion-prompt（约 2900 star）
15 种 MG 动态设计风格，每种一支 10 秒成片，全部由 Claude Opus 5.5 写代码做出来。

author: dextune
text:
SUPRA-Tex

SUPRA-Tex generates textured 3D assets from a single image while preserving fine details like lettering, patterns, and material boundaries.

It uses a 33.6M parameter material adapter to predict PBR materials in the reference view.

A 2.1B completion model then fills unseen surfaces using an Interleaved Flow Transformer.

A new depth prefilter reduces texture leakage near occlusion boundaries by rejecting unreliable surface observations.

The pipeline also supports texturing existing meshes and exports relightable GLB files with base color, metallic, and roughness maps.

  return pts;
}

const VS='attribute vec2 p;void main(){gl_Position=vec4(p,0.,1.);}';
const FS=`precision highp float;
uniform vec2 uRes; uniform float uTime; uniform sampler2D uField;
uniform vec4 uB[16]; uniform float uMorph; uniform float uLine; uniform float uClip;
uniform vec3 uRim; uniform vec3 uGA; uniform vec3 uGB;
const vec2 BOARD=vec2(${W}.,${H}.); const vec2 C=vec2(${CX}.,${CY}.); const float LINEY=${LINEY}.;
vec3 backdrop(vec2 b){
  vec2 u=b/BOARD; vec3 c=vec3(.008,.012,.014);
  c+=uGA*.22*exp(-dot((u-vec2(.28,.62))*vec2(1.6,2.2),(u-vec2(.28,.62))*vec2(1.6,2.2)));
  c+=uGB*.20*exp(-dot((u-vec2(.74,.38))*vec2(1.6,2.2),(u-vec2(.74,.38))*vec2(1.6,2.2)));
  vec2 g=abs(fract(b/96.)-.5); c+=vec3(.025)*smoothstep(.49,.5,max(g.x,g.y));   // 很淡的网格，折射时能看出扭曲
  return c;
}
float blobs(vec2 b){ float fb=0.;
  for(int i=0;i<16;i++){ vec4 d=uB[i]; if(d.z>0.){ vec2 q=b-d.xy;
    if(d.w>0.){ float th=atan(q.y,q.x); q/=1.+d.w*(.045*sin(3.*th+uTime*3.1)+.028*sin(5.*th-uTime*2.3)+.025*sin(2.*th+uTime*1.7)); }
    else if(d.w<0.){ q*=vec2(.22,1.7); }
    fb+=d.z*d.z/(dot(q,q)+1.); } }
  return fb; }
float field(vec2 b){
  float fb=blobs(b); vec4 tx=texture2D(uField,b/BOARD); float fm=tx.r*2., fmB=tx.g*2.;
  float letters=mix(fmB,fm,smoothstep(.45,1.,uMorph))*(.3+.7*smoothstep(0.,.5,uMorph));
  return min(max(fb*(1.-smoothstep(.35,.85,uMorph)),letters),3.); }
void main(){
  vec2 f=gl_FragCoord.xy; f.y=uRes.y-f.y;
  float s=min(uRes.x/BOARD.x,uRes.y/BOARD.y); vec2 b=(f-uRes*.5)/s+BOARD*.5;
  vec3 col=backdrop(b);
  float lw=smoothstep(0.,1.,uLine)*(1.-smoothstep(0.,1.,abs(b.x-C.x)/(700.*uLine+1.)));
  col+=vec3(.85,1.,.95)*exp(-pow((b.y-LINEY)/1.4,2.))*lw*.9 + vec3(.4,.9,.75)*exp(-pow((b.y-LINEY)/12.,2.))*lw*.1;
  float fv=field(b); float a=smoothstep(.97,1.03,fv);
  if(uClip>0.) a*=mix(1.,smoothstep(LINEY+2.,LINEY-2.,b.y),uClip);
  if(a>0.){
    float e=2.;
    float ex=smoothstep(1.,1.9,field(b+vec2(e,0.)))-smoothstep(1.,1.9,field(b-vec2(e,0.)));
    float ey=smoothstep(1.,1.9,field(b+vec2(0.,e)))-smoothstep(1.,1.9,field(b-vec2(0.,e)));
    float inner=smoothstep(1.,1.9,fv), rim=1.-inner;
    vec3 n=normalize(vec3(-ex*3.,ey*3.,1.));
    vec2 rb=b+n.xy*vec2(60.,-60.)-(b-C)*.12*inner;
    vec3 refr=vec3(backdrop(rb+n.xy*4.).r,backdrop(rb).g,backdrop(rb-n.xy*4.).b)*1.3+.02;
    float hue=atan(n.y,n.x)*2.+uTime*.8+fv*2.;
    vec3 iri=mix(.5+.5*cos(hue+vec3(0.,2.1,4.2)),uRim,.45);
    vec3 c=refr*(1.-.2*rim)+pow(rim,2.2)*(iri*.75+.35);
    c+=pow(max(dot(n,normalize(vec3(-.5,.55,.68))),0.),40.)*1.1+.05*inner;
    col=mix(col,c,a);
  }
  gl_FragColor=vec4(col,1.);
}`;
function sh(t,s){const o=gl.createShader(t);gl.shaderSource(o,s);gl.compileShader(o);
  if(!gl.getShaderParameter(o,gl.COMPILE_STATUS))throw new Error(gl.getShaderInfoLog(o));return o;}
const prog=gl.createProgram(); gl.attachShader(prog,sh(gl.VERTEX_SHADER,VS)); gl.attachShader(prog,sh(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER,FS));
gl.bindAttribLocation(prog,0,'p'); gl.linkProgram(prog); gl.useProgram(prog);
gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,gl.createBuffer()); gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,new Float32Array([-1,-1,3,-1,-1,3]),gl.STATIC_DRAW);
gl.enableVertexAttribArray(0); gl.vertexAttribPointer(0,2,gl.FLOAT,false,0,0);
const U={}; ['uRes','uTime','uField','uB','uMorph','uLine','uClip','uRim','uGA','uGB'].forEach(k=>U[k]=gl.getUniformLocation(prog,k));
const fc=wordField(); const BEADS=beadTargets(fc);
const tx=gl.createTexture(); gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0); gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D,tx);
gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D,0,gl.RGBA,gl.RGBA,gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE,fc);
[gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER,gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER].forEach(p=>gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,p,gl.LINEAR));
[gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S,gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T].forEach(p=>gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,p,gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE));
gl.uniform1i(U.uField,0); gl.uniform3fv(U.uRim,BRAND.rim); gl.uniform3fv(U.uGA,BRAND.glowA); gl.uniform3fv(U.uGB,BRAND.glowB);

const SATS=[{x:-420,y:-140,r:22,at:.38},{x:450,y:100,r:17,at:.50}];
function blobsAt(t){
  const out=new Float32Array(64), em=seg(T.emerge,t), fl=seg(T.float,t), sp=seg(T.split,t);
  let r=0, x=CX, y=LINEY+BR;
  if (t>=T.emerge[0]){ y=LINEY+BR*.9-(LINEY+BR*.9-CY)*eIO(em)-22*Math.sin(Math.PI*ss(.55,1,em)); r=BR*(.55+.45*eOut(em));
    y+=Math.sin(t*1.6)*6*ss(0,.3,fl); x+=Math.sin(t*1.1)*4*ss(0,.3,fl); }
  if (t>=T.split[0]){ r*=1-.45*ss(0,.35,sp); r*=1-ss(.3,.85,sp); }
  out.set([x,y,r,r>0?1+.8*ss(.2,.6,sp):0],0);
  SATS.forEach((s,i)=>{ const k=clamp((fl-s.at)/.3,0,1), e=eIO(k), rr=fl>=s.at&&k<1?s.r*(1-ss(.75,1,k)):0;
    out.set([CX+s.x*(1-e),CY+s.y*(1-e)+Math.sin(t*2+i)*5,rr,0],(1+i)*4); });
  const pool=t>=T.emerge[0]?58*Math.sin(Math.PI*clamp(em*1.1,0,1)):0; out.set([CX,LINEY+7,Math.max(0,pool),-1],12);
  BEADS.forEach((p,i)=>{ const dl=Math.abs(i-5.5)/5.5*.25, k=clamp((sp-.25-dl)/.6,0,1), e=eOut(k);
    const br=t>=T.split[0]?30*ss(0,.35,k):0;
    out.set([x+(p[0]-x)*e, y+(p[1]-y)*e-34*Math.sin(Math.PI*e)*(i%2?1:-1), br, br>0?.5:0],(4+i)*4); });
  return out;
}
let t0=performance.now(); document.getElementById('replay').onclick=()=>{t0=performance.now();};
const freeze=new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('freeze');
function frame(now){
  fit(); let t=freeze!==null?parseFloat(freeze):(now-t0)/1000;
  if (BRAND.loop && t>T.end){ t0=now; t=0; }
  gl.viewport(0,0,cv.width,cv.height);
  gl.uniform2f(U.uRes,cv.width,cv.height); gl.uniform1f(U.uTime,t);
  gl.uniform4fv(U.uB,blobsAt(t)); gl.uniform1f(U.uMorph,eIO(seg(T.morph,t)));
  gl.uniform1f(U.uLine,ss(T.line[0],T.line[1],t)*(1-ss(T.emerge[0]+.6,T.float[0]+.4,t)));
  gl.uniform1f(U.uClip,1-ss(.55,.8,seg(T.emerge,t)));
  gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES,0,3);
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

text: little after effects exercise
code_src:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh">
<!-- AI 复刻：@sebiiweby After Effects exercise — kinetic type + grid + anime impact overlays；可换文案/配色 -->
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Kinetic Impact Grid</title>
<style>
:root{
  --line1:YOU; --line2:NEVER;
  --ink:#0a0a0a; --grid:#cfcfcf; --pink:#f3b7c8; --purple:#7b3db8; --red:#e2233a; --eye:#ff4fd8;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0}
html,body{height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#fff;font-family:Impact,"Arial Narrow",ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif}
canvas{display:block;width:100%;height:100%}
</style>
</head>
<body><canvas id="c"></canvas>
<script>
const cv=document.getElementById('c'),x=cv.getContext('2d');
let W,H,dpr=devicePixelRatio||1;
const DUR=9000;
function rs(){W=cv.clientWidth;H=cv.clientHeight;cv.width=W*dpr;cv.height=H*dpr;x.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0)}
rs();addEventListener('resize',rs);
const css=getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);
const COL={ink:css.getPropertyValue('--ink').trim()||'#0a0a0a',grid:css.getPropertyValue('--grid').trim()||'#cfcfcf',pink:css.getPropertyValue('--pink').trim()||'#f3b7c8',purple:css.getPropertyValue('--purple').trim()||'#7b3db8',red:css.getPropertyValue('--red').trim()||'#e2233a',eye:css.getPropertyValue('--eye').trim()||'#ff4fd8'};
const L1=(css.getPropertyValue('--line1').trim()||'YOU').replace(/"/g,'');
const L2=(css.getPropertyValue('--line2').trim()||'NEVER').replace(/"/g,'');

function lerp(a,b,t){return a+(b-a)*t}
function clamp(v,a,b){return Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v))}
function ease(t){return t<.5?2*t*t:1-Math.pow(-2*t+2,2)/2}
function seg(t,a,b){return clamp((t-a)/(b-a),0,1)}

function grid(bg,line,alpha){
  x.fillStyle=bg;x.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  x.strokeStyle=line;x.globalAlpha=alpha;x.lineWidth=1;
  const s=Math.max(18,Math.min(W,H)/22);
  x.beginPath();
  for(let gx=0;gx<=W;gx+=s){x.moveTo(gx+.5,0);x.lineTo(gx+.5,H)}
  for(let gy=0;gy<=H;gy+=s){x.moveTo(0,gy+.5);x.lineTo(W,gy+.5)}
  x.stroke();x.globalAlpha=1;
}
function speedLines(cx,cy,n,a){
  x.save();x.translate(cx,cy);x.globalAlpha=a;x.strokeStyle='#fff';x.lineWidth=2;
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const ang=i/n*Math.PI*2;
    const r0=Math.min(W,H)*(.08+ (i%3)*.02), r1=Math.min(W,H)*(.55+(i%5)*.05);
    x.beginPath();x.moveTo(Math.cos(ang)*r0,Math.sin(ang)*r0);x.lineTo(Math.cos(ang)*r1,Math.sin(ang)*r1);x.stroke();
  }
  x.restore();
}
function jagged(cx,cy,r,rot,col){
  x.save();x.translate(cx,cy);x.rotate(rot);x.fillStyle=col;x.beginPath();
  const spikes=10;for(let i=0;i<spikes;i++){
    const a=i/spikes*Math.PI*2, rr=i%2?r:r*.55;
    const px=Math.cos(a)*rr,py=Math.sin(a)*rr;
    if(i===0)x.moveTo(px,py);else x.lineTo(px,py);
  }
  x.closePath();x.fill();x.restore();
}
function heartPath(cx,cy,s){
  x.beginPath();
  for(let i=0;i<=60;i++){
    const t=i/60*Math.PI*2;
    const hx=16*Math.pow(Math.sin(t),3);
    const hy=-(13*Math.cos(t)-5*Math.cos(2*t)-2*Math.cos(3*t)-Math.cos(4*t));
    const px=cx+hx*s, py=cy+hy*s;
    if(i===0)x.moveTo(px,py);else x.lineTo(px,py);
  }
}
function voxelDude(cx,cy,sc,ghost){
  x.save();x.translate(cx,cy);x.scale(sc,sc);x.globalAlpha=ghost?0.35:1;
  // body blocks
  x.fillStyle=ghost?'#555':'#5a3a28';x.fillRect(-18,-10,36,34);
  x.fillStyle=ghost?'#777':'#c4a07a';x.fillRect(-14,-34,28,28); // head
  x.fillStyle='#2a1a12';x.fillRect(-16,-38,32,10); // hair
  x.fillStyle='#fff';x.fillRect(-10,-26,8,8);x.fillRect(2,-26,8,8);
  x.fillStyle=COL.eye;x.fillRect(-8,-24,4,4);x.fillRect(4,-24,4,4);
  if(!ghost){
    x.fillStyle=COL.red;
    for(const p of [[-6,-18],[8,-14],[-4,0],[10,6],[-12,12],[6,16]]){x.fillRect(p[0],p[1],5,5)}
  }
  x.restore();
}
function typeBlock(t){
  const enter=ease(seg(t,0.05,0.28));
  const tilt=lerp(18, -6, enter);
  const y=lerp(H*0.15, H*0.42, enter);
  const sc=lerp(1.6, 1, enter)*Math.min(W,H)/420;
  x.save();
  x.translate(W*0.5, y);
  x.rotate(tilt*Math.PI/180);
  x.scale(sc,sc);
  x.textAlign='center';x.textBaseline='middle';
  x.fillStyle=COL.ink;
  x.font='900 92px Impact, "Arial Narrow", sans-serif';
  x.letterSpacing='-0.06em';
  const slide=lerp(-80,0,enter);
  x.fillText(L1, -70+slide, -10);
  x.font='900 110px Impact, "Arial Narrow", sans-serif';
  x.fillText(L2, 40-slide*0.4, 50);
  x.restore();
}

function frame(now){
  const t=((now % DUR)/DUR);
  // background morph
  const pinkAmt=ease(seg(t,0.22,0.4))*(1-ease(seg(t,0.82,0.95)));
  const bg=`rgb(${lerp(255,243,pinkAmt)|0},${lerp(255,183,pinkAmt)|0},${lerp(255,200,pinkAmt)|0})`;
  const gl=`rgba(${lerp(180,180,pinkAmt)|0},${lerp(180,80,pinkAmt)|0},${lerp(180,120,pinkAmt)|0},0.55)`;
  grid(bg, gl, 0.9);

  // kinetic type early / late
  if(t<0.35 || t>0.85) typeBlock(t<0.35?t: lerp(0.3,0.05,seg(t,0.85,1)));

  const cx=W*0.5, cy=H*0.52;
  // impact phase
  if(t>0.28 && t<0.88){
    const a=ease(seg(t,0.28,0.4))*(1-ease(seg(t,0.78,0.88)));
    speedLines(cx,cy,36,a*0.85);
    jagged(W*0.78,H*0.22, Math.min(W,H)*0.14, t*2, COL.purple);
    // red bars
    x.save();x.globalAlpha=a*0.9;x.fillStyle=COL.red;
    x.translate(W*0.42,H*0.18);x.rotate(-0.4);x.fillRect(0,0,10,H*0.22);x.fillRect(18,0,10,H*0.18);
    x.restore();
    // heart swoosh
    x.save();x.globalAlpha=a;x.strokeStyle=COL.purple;x.lineWidth=2.5;
    heartPath(cx+Math.sin(t*20)*4, cy-20, Math.min(W,H)/90);
    x.stroke();
    x.beginPath();x.arc(cx,cy,Math.min(W,H)*0.28, -0.2, Math.PI*1.3);x.stroke();
    x.restore();

    // voxel dudes with vibration
    const vib=(Math.random()-0.5)*6*a;
    const pop=ease(seg(t,0.34,0.48));
    if(pop>0){
      voxelDude(cx-30+vib, cy+10, Math.min(W,H)/220*pop, false);
      if(t>0.45) voxelDude(cx+40+vib*0.5, cy+6, Math.min(W,H)/240*pop, true);
      if(t>0.55) voxelDude(cx+10-vib, cy-5, Math.min(W,H)/200, false);
    }
    // diagonal white streaks
    x.save();x.globalAlpha=a*0.7;x.strokeStyle='#fff';x.lineWidth=3;
    for(let i=0;i<8;i++){x.beginPath();x.moveTo(W*0.1+i*20, H*0.2);x.lineTo(W*0.4+i*20, H*0.85);x.stroke()}
    x.restore();
  }

  // flash
  if(t>0.46 && t<0.5){x.fillStyle=`rgba(255,255,255,${1-seg(t,0.46,0.5)})`;x.fillRect(0,0,W,H)}
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>
</body></html>

<body><canvas id="c"></canvas>
<script>
const cv=document.getElementById('c'),x=cv.getContext('2d');
let W,H,dpr=devicePixelRatio||1,t0=performance.now();
function rs(){W=cv.clientWidth;H=cv.clientHeight;cv.width=W*dpr;cv.height=H*dpr;x.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0)}
rs();addEventListener('resize',rs);
function draw(now){
  const t=(now-t0)/1000;x.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  // overcast sky
  const sky=x.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  sky.addColorStop(0,'#8a939c');sky.addColorStop(.55,'#6e767e');sky.addColorStop(1,'#4d555c');
  x.fillStyle=sky;x.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  // orange core
  const cx=W*.52,cy=H*.28,R=Math.min(W,H)*.09*(1+Math.sin(t*1.2)*.04);
  const core=x.createRadialGradient(cx,cy,0,cx,cy,R*3.2);
  core.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,170,60,.95)');core.addColorStop(.25,'rgba(255,90,40,.55)');core.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,80,30,0)');
  x.fillStyle=core;x.beginPath();x.arc(cx,cy,R*3.2,0,7);x.fill();
  x.fillStyle='#ffb45a';x.beginPath();x.arc(cx,cy,R*.45,0,7);x.fill();
  // ribbon
  x.beginPath();x.moveTo(W*.05,H*.02);
  for(let i=0;i<=40;i++){
    const u=i/40;const px=W*(.05+u*.55)+Math.sin(u*6+t)*.02*W;
    const py=H*(.02+u*.32+Math.sin(u*3.5+t*.8)*.04);
    x.lineTo(px,py);
  }
  x.strokeStyle='rgba(240,240,245,.85)';x.lineWidth=Math.max(6,W*.012);x.lineCap='round';x.stroke();
  // city blocks
  x.fillStyle='#3a4046';
  for(let i=0;i<18;i++){
    const bx=W*(.15+i*.04), bw=W*.03*(1+(i%3)*.3), bh=H*(.12+(i%5)*.05);
    x.fillRect(bx,H*.55-bh,bw,bh+H*.2);
  }
  // mecha silhouette
  x.save();x.translate(W*.48,H*.52);x.scale(Math.min(W,H)/500,Math.min(W,H)/500);
  x.fillStyle='#c5ced6';x.strokeStyle='#2a3036';x.lineWidth=2;
  x.beginPath();x.moveTo(-18,-90);x.lineTo(10,-100);x.lineTo(22,-40);x.lineTo(18,40);x.lineTo(-10,50);x.lineTo(-22,-20);x.closePath();x.fill();x.stroke();
  x.fillStyle='#e07a32';x.fillRect(-28,-70,18,14);x.fillRect(8,-66,16,12);
  x.beginPath();x.moveTo(18,-20);x.lineTo(70,-110);x.strokeStyle='#d0d6dc';x.lineWidth=4;x.stroke();
  x.restore();
  // red blast
  const blast=x.createRadialGradient(W*.78,H*.48,0,W*.78,H*.48,W*.18);
  blast.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,60,40,.7)');blast.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,40,20,0)');
  x.fillStyle=blast;x.beginPath();x.arc(W*.78,H*.48,W*.18,0,7);x.fill();
  // foreground trees
  x.fillStyle='#2f4a32';
  for(let i=0;i<7;i++){const tx=W*(.05+i*.14);x.beginPath();x.ellipse(tx,H*.9,W*.06,H*.12,0,0,7);x.fill()}
  x.fillStyle='rgba(20,24,28,.25)';x.fillRect(0,H*.82,W,H*.2);
  requestAnimationFrame(draw);
}
requestAnimationFrame(draw);
</script></body></html>

author: gkxspace
text:
蛙趣，刚用 Opus5.5 + Hi3D 跑一个通宵搓的游戏，这个精细度，真的很哇塞！

Opus5.5编排 + Image-2.5 出图 + Hi3D MCP 做模 + Three.js 装配

整套做法分享给大家：
1、概念与多视角参考图：GPT-Image-2.5
先让 GPT-Image-2.5 出多视角的概念图和参考图（正面、侧面、背面），把材质纹理和结构确定。

2、高精 3D 资产建模：Hi3D MCP
把 Hi3D 的 MCP 接进 AI工具，需要时会把参考图喂给 Hi3D MCP，秒级生成带完整 PBR 材质的高精 3D Mesh。

3、Web 端性能优化：自动减面与 Draco 压缩（关键避坑点）
AI 生成的原生模型动辄几十万面，直接丢进网页必卡，让 AI 调用 MCP 时加入 LOD 网格简化并压成 Draco 格式的 glb。

4、逻辑与场景组装：Three.js / WebGL
模型就绪后，AI 自动编写 Loader 异步加载，补齐物理碰撞体、海水着色器、光影和粒子特效，拼成完整可交互的世界。

5、音效和配乐：WebAudio 实时合成

另外，@Hi3D_AI 刚把 V1.0 开源了，由 200 万真实生产资产训出，细节还原和多视角保真都很顶，堪称目前最扎实的工业级开源 3D 模型，摆明就是奔着 3D 赛道的 AI Infra 去的。
effect_zh: Opus + Hi3D MCP + Three.js 通宵管线：概念多视角→建模→网页装配，AI 做 3D 游戏/展示的工作流示范。
